framing: A face on this list used as the display voice or as the only face needs a reason recorded in DESIGN.md (SLP-20, soft tell). This is a dated warning list, not a ban list and not a quality judgement: several of these faces became common because they are good. No alternatives are recommended, because every recommended list so far became the next saturated list (ADR-012). The list is Latin-only and is reviewed with the tell statuses.
requires: a recorded reason in DESIGN.md (the job the face does that no other candidate does); an association with the subject alone is not that reason
exempt: brand faces on their own domains (for example Geist on Vercel's site, Roboto on Google's, Mona Sans on GitHub's)
a face declared for body and UI text on Operate and Read surfaces
a face the brand commits to
match_note: `match` lists lower-case family-name forms a detector compares after removing quotes, weights and variable suffixes; next/font class names such as __Inter_1a2b3c reduce to the family name.

first-order.description: Configured defaults of the dominant stack, as the display or only face.

second-order.description: Where the escape from first-order defaults converged, partly because 2025 prompting guidance recommended these faces.

house-style.description: Named in model house styles and default rosters.
